Class ClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.socket.ClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ClientHandler extends Object implements Runnable
Handles a single client connection on the server side.

This class is responsible for:

  • Managing input/output streams with the client
  • Receiving and dispatching messages to the GameController
  • Handling client registration
  • Managing client-specific errors and disconnection

Each instance runs on its own thread and represents one connected client.

      Throws:
      IOException - if stream initialization fails

    • clientLoop

      private void clientLoop()
      Continuously reads messages from the client while the connection is active.

      The first valid message must always be a RegisterMessage. Any other message before registration is ignored.

    • handleDisconnection

      private void handleDisconnection()
      Marks the player as disconnected and notifies the associated GameController.

      If the player was part of an active game, the controller is informed via GameController.onPlayerDisconnected(String). Repeated calls are ignored to avoid duplicate disconnection handling.

    • handleMessage

      private void handleMessage(Message message) throws IOException
      Handles an incoming message from the client.

      - If the message is a RegisterMessage, it triggers registration. - If the client is not registered, other messages are ignored. - Otherwise, the message is executed on the server side through the controller.

      If a game-related exception occurs, an error message is sent only to this client.

      Parameters:
      message - the received message from the client
      Throws:
      IOException - if sending responses to the client fails

    • handleGetLobby

      private void handleGetLobby(GetLobbyMessage msg) throws IOException
      Handles the initial lobby registration for a connecting client.

      Assigns the player's nickname, creates a SocketVirtualView for them, and delegates lobby registration to ServerState. If registration fails, an ErrorMessage is sent to the client and the socket is closed.

      Parameters:
      msg - the GetLobbyMessage containing the player's chosen nickname
      Throws:
      IOException - if sending the error response or closing the socket fails

    • cleanup

      private void cleanup()
      Releases all resources associated with this client connection.

      Always called when the client disconnects, whether due to an error or a normal closure. Specifically:

      • If the player was part of an active game, their slot is preserved to allow reconnection; disconnection is already handled by handleDisconnection().
      • If the player had not yet joined any game, they are removed from ServerState entirely.
      In both cases, the virtual view connection is unregistered and the socket is closed.
